title: Dislocate
summary: DISLOCATE, verb transitive [dis and locate, Latin , place.] To displace; to put out of its proper place; particularly, to put out of joint; to disjoint; to move a bone from its socket, cavity or place

inlines.v: DISLOCATE, verb transitive [dis and locate, Latin , place.] To displace; to put out of its proper place; particularly, to put out of joint; to disjoint; to move a bone from its socket, cavity or place of articulation.
